camel_example: aliyun dds ModifySrvNetworkAddress --region cn-hangzhou --ConnectionType VPC --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp1fd530f2710000' --NewConnectionString aliyuntest111
description_en: Modifies the SRV connection address of a MongoDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-srv-network-address --db-instance-id dds-bp1fd530f2710000 --new-connection-string aliyuntest111 --connection-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySrvNetworkAddress

parameters.help_en:
The new connection address. The address must meet the following requirements:

Starts with a lowercase letter.

Ends with a lowercase letter or a digit.

Contains only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

Is 8 to 63 characters in length.

You only need to specify the prefix of the connection address. The rest of the address cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
新的连接地址，要求如下：
以小写字母开头。
以小写字母或数字结尾。
由小写字母、数字和连字符（-） 组成。
长度为8~63个字符。

仅需传入连接地址的前缀部分，前缀以外的部分不可修改
parameters.name: new_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SRV connection address to modify. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)

Public: Internet connection
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的SRV地址类型，可选值：
VPC：专有网络
Public：公网连接
parameters.name: connection_type
